say:0:1111501001:0.text: The Dusk Lord's final resting place is, in fact, a tomb.
say:0:1111501001:0.source_cn: 残阳神的安眠之地，也就是残阳神的墓穴。

say:1:1111501002:0.text: Upon reaching it, care must be taken not to offend the gods.
say:1:1111501002:0.source_cn: 到了这个地方，务必谨言慎行，不可冒犯了神明。

say:0:1111501101:0.text: This tomb is magnificent. I wonder what secrets all of these stone tablets hold.
say:0:1111501101:0.source_cn: 这座墓穴很宏伟，四处都立着不少石碑，不知道上面记载了什么。

say:0:1111502001:0.text: It seems we must find the key to delve deeper.
say:0:1111502001:0.source_cn: 要想深入墓穴，还要找到钥匙……

say:1:1111502002:0.text: It's clear the Dusk Lord really doesn't wish to be disturbed...
say:1:1111502002:0.source_cn: 唉……看得出残阳神很不想被打扰了。

say:2:1111502003:0.text: We are here to aid him, not cause any disturbance.
say:2:1111502003:0.source_cn: 我们是来帮祂解决问题的，不算打扰。

say:0:1111503001:0.text: There are two keys in total. We must find both to continue.
say:0:1111503001:0.source_cn: 总共有两把钥匙，我们要先找到钥匙才能继续前进。

say:0:1111504001:0.text: This reads like an epitaph for the Dusk Lord, detailing his fall.
say:0:1111504001:0.source_cn: 这仿佛是写给残阳神的墓志铭，记载着他陨落时的故事。

say:0:1111504101:0.text: Koko! Do not wander aimlessly, and be careful not to fall!
say:0:1111504101:0.source_cn: 卡卡！你不要东摸摸西看看，小心掉下悬崖！

say:1:1111504102:0.text: I'm looking around to keep everyone safe!
say:1:1111504102:0.source_cn: 我是在观察周围，为了保护大家！

say:0:1111504201:0.text: Where are we now? Antandra, your sense of direction is poor at best, so stay close.
say:0:1111504201:0.source_cn: 这是飞到哪里来了？安丹，你不怎么认路，可千万别和我走散。

say:0:1111504301:0.text: You are finally here... Come and find me! I'm waiting for you at the deepest level.
say:0:1111504301:0.source_cn: 你们终于来了……来吧……快来寻找我！我在最深处等着你们。

say:1:1111504302:0.text: In the deepest part? Wow! Will we see the Dusk Lord?
say:1:1111504302:0.source_cn: 在最深处等待？哇！我们是不是会见到残阳神？

say:2:1111504303:0.text: The Dusk Lord has fallen. This is his tomb. It's definitely not him talking.
say:2:1111504303:0.source_cn: 残阳神已经陨落了，否则哪来的这座墓穴？肯定不是祂在说话。

say:0:1111505001:0.text: The hidden key must be found to move on, but where could it be?
say:0:1111505001:0.source_cn: 想要继续前进，必须得找到隐藏起来的钥匙，钥匙会在哪里呢？

say:1:1111505002:0.text: Let's check for any peculiar mechanisms.
say:1:1111505002:0.source_cn: 先看看有没有什么可疑的机关。
say:1:1111505002:0.male: Let's check for any peculiar mechanisms.
say:1:1111505002:0.female: Let's check for any peculiar mechanisms.

say:0:1111506001:0.text: One... two! We have the keys! Now to the door!
say:0:1111506001:0.source_cn: 一把……两把！钥匙齐全啦！去找那扇关着的大门吧！

say:0:1111507001:0.text: It's open! We can move forward!
say:0:1111507001:0.source_cn: 大门成功开启，可以继续前进了！

say:0:1111508001:0.text: It feels like... the Mark of the Setting Sun.
say:0:1111508001:0.source_cn: 感觉到了……是残阳神的力量。

say:1:1111508002:0.source_cn: 还有另外一股强大的力量……

say:3:1111508004:0.text: It doesn't seem quite the same.
say:3:1111508004:0.male: It doesn't seem quite the same.
say:3:1111508004:0.female: It doesn't seem quite the same.

say:0:1111509001:0.text: The inscription is quite damaged... difficult to decipher.
say:0:1111509001:0.source_cn: 碑文被严重腐蚀了……难以辨认。

say:1:1111509002:0.text: Time alone would not be enough to damage this inscription, Magister. This is the work of foul magic.
say:1:1111509002:0.source_cn: 漫长的时间不足以将碑文腐蚀成这样，主人，这是污秽魔力造成的。
say:1:1111509002:0.male: Time alone would not be enough to damage this inscription, Magister. This is the work of foul magic.
say:1:1111509002:0.female: Time alone would not be enough to damage this inscription, Magister. This is the work of foul magic.

say:0:1111510001:0.text: Now that you have made it this far, I believe you can handle the challenges ahead.
say:0:1111510001:0.source_cn: 既然你们已经走到了这里，我相信你们能够应对接下来的挑战。

say:1:1111510002:0.text: Go ahead and face your fate. Do battle... and then come find me.
say:1:1111510002:0.source_cn: 去吧，面对你们的命运。打败它……然后，来到我的面前。

say:2:1111510003:0.source_cn: 我怎么有种不安的预感……

say:1:1111511002:0.text: A tough nut to crack... interesting.
say:1:1111511002:0.source_cn: 它看着是个硬骨头，有意思。

say:0:1111512001:0.text: That was close... if it were anyone else, they would not have survived.
say:0:1111512001:0.source_cn: 好险啊……换做其他人，一定早被这个守卫的利器干掉了。

say:1:1111512002:0.text: More sinister forces are looming ahead! Everyone, stay on your guard.
say:1:1111512002:0.source_cn: 前方还有更加邪恶的力量蠢蠢欲动！大家不要松懈。

say:1:1111513002:0.text: The Hypogean's aura is getting stronger. Should we rest awhile?
say:1:1111513002:0.source_cn: 恶魔的气息越来越强烈，你要不要休息一下？

say:2:1111513003:0.text: No need... I won't slow us down.
say:2:1111513003:0.source_cn: 不用……我不想拖累大家的脚步……

say:0:1111513101:0.text: Tread with care! This place appears bottomless!
say:0:1111513101:0.source_cn: 这地方一眼望不见底，大家小心，别掉下去了！

say:0:1111513201:0.text: Wow... these stairs go on forever...

say:1:1111513202:0.text: Stay alert, no telling what awaits us at the end.
say:1:1111513202:0.source_cn: 警觉些，不知道在尽头等待我们的是什么。

say:0:1111513301:0.text: Magister, look at the light! This warm feeling is... familiar.
say:0:1111513301:0.source_cn: 梅林，你看那道光！这温暖的感觉……我很熟悉。
say:0:1111513301:0.male: Magister, look at the light! This warm feeling is... familiar.
say:0:1111513301:0.female: Magister, look at the light! This warm feeling is... familiar.

say:0:1111513401:0.text: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.
say:0:1111513401:0.source_cn: 梅林！来……来吧！我是如此迫切地与你相见！
say:0:1111513401:0.male: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.
say:0:1111513401:0.female: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.

say:1:1111513402:0.text: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!
say:1:1111513402:0.source_cn: 竟然说出了主人的身份！这声音的源头到底从哪来？
say:1:1111513402:0.male: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!
say:1:1111513402:0.female: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!

say:2:1111513403:0.text: Down there! At the end of this long, dark staircase!
say:2:1111513403:0.source_cn: 在下面！在这漫长而幽深的长阶尽头！

say:0:1111514001:0.text: Wow! A huge stone tablet ahead!
say:0:1111514001:0.source_cn: 哇！前面有一块好大的石碑！

say:1:1111514002:0.text: Wait, this signature... could it be...?!

say:2:1111515001:0.text: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!
say:2:1111515001:0.source_cn: 这竟然是女神艾雅留下的石碑！主人，艾雅大人早知道您会来！
say:2:1111515001:0.male: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!
say:2:1111515001:0.female: This stone tablet was left by Dura! Magister, Dura knew you would come!

say:3:1111515002:0.text: Now is not the time for joy. Things are much different than we thought... There is a Hypogean sealed in the Dusk Lord's tomb!
say:3:1111515002:0.source_cn: 现在可不是高兴的时候。这跟我们先前的猜测不一样，残阳神...

say:4:1111515003:0.text: Even worse, just as Dura feared, Illucia's actions in the Remnant Peaks have weakened the seal.
say:4:1111515003:0.source_cn: 更糟糕的是……正如艾雅大人担心的那样，由于伊露西卡在遗...

say:5:1111515004:0.text: It seems this is the root cause of the anomalies in the Crimson Highlands—the Hypogean's power is extending outward.
say:5:1111515004:0.source_cn: 看来，这才是深红高地出现异常的根本原因——恶魔的力量正...

say:9:1111515005:1.text: Does the inscription say that if we want to seal that horrid thing in again—that is, the Hypogean, we need to defeat it?
say:9:1111515005:1.source_cn: 这碑文是不是说，如果我们想要再次封印那东西……也就是…...

say:10:1111515006:1.text: Ah! I can't stand uttering such a filthy word!
say:10:1111515006:1.source_cn: 啊！受不了……真不想从我口中说出这么污秽的词语！

say:11:1111515007:0.text: My understanding is the same as yours. However, although the Hypogean's seal has been compromised, it is still in a contained state.
say:11:1111515007:0.source_cn: 我的理解和你一样。可是，虽然恶魔的封印出现了瑕疵，但它...

say:12:1111515008:0.text: We cannot defeat the Hypogean while it remains confined. Does that mean we need to...
say:12:1111515008:0.source_cn: 我们无法与被封印的恶魔战斗，如果想要与其一战，这不就意...

choice_prompt:13:1111515008.text: We cannot defeat the Hypogean while it remains confined. Does that mean we need to...
choice_prompt:13:1111515008.source_cn: 我们无法与被封印的恶魔战斗，如果想要与其一战，这不就意味着我们必须……

say:14:1111515009:0.text: Wait! Unseal that... thing?! Can we really do this?
say:14:1111515009:0.source_cn: 等等！要解开那东西的封印？现在？这么做能行吗……

say:15:1111515010:0.text: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.
say:15:1111515010:0.source_cn: 主人掌握着封印恶魔的魔法术式，想要解除封印的话，只需将...
say:15:1111515010:0.male: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.
say:15:1111515010:0.female: The magister knows the magical process of sealing a Hypogean. To release it, the method is simply reversed.

say:16:1111515011:0.text: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.
say:16:1111515011:0.source_cn: 对于主人这样伟大的魔法师来说，不是什么难事。
say:16:1111515011:0.male: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.
say:16:1111515011:0.female: For a great mage like the magister, this should be a small task.

say:17:1111515012:0.text: That's not what I mean... we're discussing the release of a malevolent Hypogean! Shouldn't we be cautious?
say:17:1111515012:0.source_cn: 我不是担心这个……我的意思是，那可是恶魔啊！不该慎之又慎吗？

say:18:1111515013:0.text: At least let me perform a divination on the probability of our success...
say:18:1111515013:0.source_cn: 起码先让我对获胜的概率做个占卜……

say:19:1111515014:0.text: I agree with Satrana. We need to be careful with how we proceed.
say:19:1111515014:0.source_cn: 我赞同萨忒娜的观点，谨慎为好。

say:20:1111515015:0.text: Even if we truly can lift the seal, there's no guarantee we'll defeat the Hypogean. The results of failure would be catastrophic.
say:20:1111515015:0.source_cn: 就算我们能解除恶魔的封印，可是没人能保证，我们一定可以...

say:21:1111515016:0.text: However, since the seal has already been compromised, it's only a matter of time before it shatters.
say:21:1111515016:0.source_cn: 不过，封印既然已经出现了裂痕，迟早会彻底破损。

say:22:1111515017:0.text: The Crimson Highlands and all the surrounding areas will...
say:22:1111515017:0.source_cn: 更别说在那之前，整个深红高原，乃至周边恐怕都……

say:25:1111515018:0.text: What will happen?! Finish your words!
say:25:1111515018:0.source_cn: 都会怎样？安丹姐！你把话说完啊！

say:26:1111515019:0.text: Koko, if we don't fight the Hypogean, your homeland will be destroyed long before the seal is fully broken.
say:26:1111515019:0.source_cn: 卡卡，如果我们不与恶魔战斗，恐怕在他的封印彻底破溃前，...

say:27:1111515020:0.text: Then I'll fight! I'm not afraid of pain, only of losing my home!
say:27:1111515020:0.source_cn: 卡卡要战斗！卡卡不怕受伤，卡卡害怕失去家园！

say:32:1111515021:0.text: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
say:32:1111515021:0.male: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
say:32:1111515021:0.female: Magister Merlin, what should we do?

choice_prompt:33:1111515021.text: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
choice_prompt:33:1111515021.male: Magister Merlin, what should we do?
choice_prompt:33:1111515021.female: Magister Merlin, what should we do?

say:36:1111515022:0.source_cn: 你应该知道我会怎么选。

say:37:1111515023:0.text: I've come this far, and I won't back down.
say:37:1111515023:0.source_cn: 已经走到这里了，我决不退缩。
say:37:1111515023:0.male: I've come this far, and I won't back down.
say:37:1111515023:0.female: I've come this far, and I won't back down.

say:41:1111515026:0.text: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!
say:41:1111515026:0.source_cn: 主人，就像女神艾雅在碑文里提到的那样，该您和同伴们出场了！
say:41:1111515026:0.male: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!
say:41:1111515026:0.female: Magister, as Dura said in the inscription, it's time for you and your companions to take a stand!

say:42:1111515027:1.text: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!
say:42:1111515027:1.source_cn: 满满永远愿意为您冲锋在前！
say:42:1111515027:1.male: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!
say:42:1111515027:1.female: And Chippy is always ready to charge ahead for you!

say:45:1111515028:1.text: Don't hog the spotlight, Chippy. Merlin also has me by his side.
say:45:1111515028:1.source_cn: 不要一个人抢功劳啊，满满。梅林身边还有我呢。
say:45:1111515028:1.male: Don't hog the spotlight, Chippy. Merlin also has me by his side.
say:45:1111515028:1.female: Don't hog the spotlight, Chippy. Merlin also has me by her side.

say:46:1111515029:1.text: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.
say:46:1111515029:1.source_cn: 不止是我，还有一路走来的各位。
say:46:1111515029:1.male: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.
say:46:1111515029:1.female: And not just me, but all of us who have come this far.

say:47:1111515030:1.text: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
say:47:1111515030:1.source_cn: 梅林，你是不是已经下定决心了？
say:47:1111515030:1.male: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
say:47:1111515030:1.female: Merlin, have you made up your mind?

choice_prompt:48:1111515030.text: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
choice_prompt:48:1111515030.source_cn: 梅林，你是不是已经下定决心了？
choice_prompt:48:1111515030.male: Merlin, have you made up your mind?
choice_prompt:48:1111515030.female: Merlin, have you made up your mind?

say:50:1111515032:1.text: Let's not delay! Time to unseal the Hypogean!
say:50:1111515032:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，我们去解开那恶魔的封印吧！

say:54:1111515024:0.text: I can't... the aura here is in flux, preventing any method of divination.
say:54:1111515024:0.source_cn: 不行……我试过了，这里的气息会干扰我，我无法做出准确的占卜。
say:54:1111515024:0.male: I can't... the aura here is in flux, preventing any method of divination.
say:54:1111515024:0.female: I can't... the aura here is in flux, preventing any method of divination.

say:55:1111515025:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, trust your instincts, and I will stand behind you no matter what!
say:55:1111515025:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, trust your instincts, and I will stand behind you no matter what!
say:55:1111515025:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, trust your instincts, and I will stand behind you no matter what!

say:0:1111516001:0.text: Are we going to fight against a nasty enemy?
say:0:1111516001:0.source_cn: 要和强大的敌人战斗了吗？

say:0:1111516101:0.text: You have come. There is no need to be afraid, for I welcome you.
say:0:1111516101:0.source_cn: 你们终于来到这里了，不必恐惧。我很欢迎你们。

say:1:1111516102:0.text: Your footsteps are as melodious as morning birds... come closer, brave children.
say:1:1111516102:0.source_cn: 你们的脚步声如此悦耳，正如清晨的鸟啼般清脆……走上前吧...

say:2:1111522002:0.text: I'm alive... I can't believe it.

say:3:1111522003:0.text: See, Antandra? I've learned much in your absence.
say:3:1111522003:0.source_cn: 安丹，看到了吗？你不在的这段时间，我也成长为可靠的战斗...

say:5:1111522004:0.source_cn: 萨忒娜姐姐！呜呜呜……萨忒娜姐姐！

say:6:1111522005:0.text: Hey, hey, easy kid! You're all over me!
say:6:1111522005:0.source_cn: 哎哎哎？你这小孩，不要突然扑过来啊！

say:7:1111522006:0.text: If not for your help in the battle, I don't think I ever would have seen Antandra again!
say:7:1111522006:0.source_cn: 要不是你在战斗中干扰敌人！我肯定再也见不到安丹姐姐了！

say:8:1111522007:0.text: I thought you just wanted to steal her away, and so I've been so cruel to you... and you still saved me! You're the best...
say:8:1111522007:0.source_cn: 我以为你会抢走安丹姐，所以一直对你很凶，你却依然愿意救...

say:9:1111522008:0.text: From now on, you and Antandra are both my favorite people!
say:9:1111522008:0.source_cn: 从现在起，你和安丹姐姐都是我最喜欢的人了！

say:10:1111522009:0.text: Hey, there can only be room for one favorite, so don't get greedy.
say:10:1111522009:0.source_cn: 哼，留着你的好意吧， 最喜欢的人只能有一个，你可不要太贪心。

say:12:1111522010:0.text: And who is Satrana's favorite person?
say:12:1111522010:0.source_cn: 谁又是萨忒娜心中最喜欢的人呢？

say:13:1111522011:0.text: Think it over slowly. With that thick skull of yours, it might be a while before you figure it out!
say:13:1111522011:0.source_cn: 你慢慢想吧，以你的死脑筋，我看你多久才能想出来！

say:18:1111522013:0.text: Will the Crimson Highlands return to normal now?
say:18:1111522013:0.source_cn: 将他封印后，深红高原就会恢复正常吗？

say:20:1111522014:0.text: Based on our previous experiences, it will take some time.
say:20:1111522014:0.source_cn: 以我们之前的经验，恢复需要时间。

say:21:1111522015:0.text: At the very least, they won't deteriorate any further. Things can only improve from here.
say:21:1111522015:0.source_cn: 起码，事态不会进一步恶化了，只会渐渐好转。

say:23:1111522016:0.text: Magister, we thwarted a Hypogean once again! Let's go back to Alkali to celebrate!
say:23:1111522016:0.source_cn: 主人，我们又一次解决了恶魔引发的危机，应该回咸水镇好好...
say:23:1111522016:0.male: Magister, we thwarted a Hypogean once again! Let's go back to Alkali to celebrate!
say:23:1111522016:0.female: Magister, we thwarted a Hypogean once again! Let's go back to Alkali to celebrate!

say:24:1111522017:0.text: We both know you only want to "celebrate" so you can go stuff your cheeks with food!
say:24:1111522017:0.source_cn: 说什么想庆祝，其实你是嘴馋了，想吃点好的吧？

say:25:1111522018:0.text: Chippy, as a familiar, you only need magic for nourishment but you're still so greedy!
say:25:1111522018:0.source_cn: 满满，你明明是一只只需要补给魔力就能生存的使魔，却那么贪吃。

say:27:1111522020:0.text: Chippy! You've even learned how to tattle!

say:28:1111522021:0.text: Help, Magister! Hammie must be stopped!
say:28:1111522021:0.source_cn: 救命啊主人！您快管管漫漫啊！
say:28:1111522021:0.male: Help, Magister! Hammie must be stopped!
say:28:1111522021:0.female: Help, Magister! Hammie must be stopped!

say:29:1111522022:0.text: This sort of bickering sounds familiar.
say:29:1111522022:0.source_cn: 久违了，这种吵吵闹闹的感觉。

say:30:1111522023:0.text: Reminds me of Alsa always buzzing in my ear.
say:30:1111522023:0.source_cn: 在阿尔萨边上，耳旁总是这种声音。

choice_prompt:31:1111522023.text: Reminds me of Alsa always buzzing in my ear.
choice_prompt:31:1111522023.source_cn: 在阿尔萨边上，耳旁总是这种声音。

say:33:1111522025:0.text: But I don't wish to remain here any longer.
say:33:1111522025:0.source_cn: 但是，我也不想在这里继续待下去。
say:33:1111522025:0.male: But I don't wish to remain here any longer.
say:33:1111522025:0.female: But I don't wish to remain here any longer.

say:34:1111522026:0.text: Let's head back to Alkali. I'm sure everyone there could use good news.
say:34:1111522026:0.source_cn: 走吧，回咸水镇。有很多人在等我们带回喜讯。
say:34:1111522026:0.male: Let's head back to Alkali. I'm sure everyone there could use good news.
say:34:1111522026:0.female: Let's head back to Alkali. I'm sure everyone there could use good news.

say:1:1111524001:0.text: Why have only a few of you returned? Did you find the treasure?
say:1:1111524001:0.source_cn: 为什么只有你们几个回来了？你们找到宝藏了？

say:4:1111524002:0.text: Papa? He's not here... Excuse me, have you seen my papa?
say:4:1111524002:0.source_cn: 阿爸呢……没有阿爸。请问，你们有没有见过我的阿爸？

say:5:1111524003:0.text: His name is Ames! He loves telling stories and keeping a journal.
say:5:1111524003:0.source_cn: 他叫阿米！他很喜欢讲故事，也很喜欢写日记。

say:6:1111524004:0.text: He said he would write down all the amazing things that happened during the treasure hunt and tell me when he got back.
say:6:1111524004:0.source_cn: 他说他会把寻宝途中各种有趣的事情都记下来，回来后讲给我听……

say:7:1111524005:0.text: Has anyone seen him? Anyone? Please... he's my papa...
say:7:1111524005:0.source_cn: 有谁见过吗？有谁……见过他吗？他是我的阿爸……

say:11:1111524007:0.text: We haven't met your father, but we found some journals along the way that may belong to him. Take a look...
say:11:1111524007:0.source_cn: 小姑娘……我们没有见过你阿爸，但我们在途中捡到了一些日...

say:15:1111524010:0.text: I knew it... every time I have a bad feeling, I'm never wrong!
say:15:1111524010:0.source_cn: 我就知道……每次遇到坏事，我的预感总是很灵！
say:15:1111524010:0.male: I knew it... every time I have a bad feeling, I'm never wrong!
say:15:1111524010:0.female: I knew it... every time I have a bad feeling, I'm never wrong!

say:16:1111524011:0.text: When Papa was leaving, I begged him not to go! Why didn't he listen to me? Why?
say:16:1111524011:0.source_cn: 阿爸走的时候我就让他不要去，可他不信！为什么呢……为什...
say:16:1111524011:0.male: When Papa was leaving, I begged him not to go! Why didn't he listen to me? Why?
say:16:1111524011:0.female: When Papa was leaving, I begged him not to go! Why didn't he listen to me? Why?

say:19:1111524014:0.text: I have to tell everyone the truth.
say:19:1111524014:0.source_cn: 我得把真相告诉所有人。

say:20:1111524015:0.text: Otherwise, those souls will not rest in the Crimson Highlands, with none aware of the evil deeds of the Hypogean and the Adamant Syndicate.
say:20:1111524015:0.source_cn: 否则那些生命只能白白沉眠于深红高地，没人知道恶魔与黑金...

say:21:1111524016:0.text: As Phraesto said, others must know of his crimes; we must empower the world to judge him.
say:21:1111524016:0.source_cn: 正如普鲁斯托所言，必须有人知道他的罪行，我们要让世人获...

say:23:1111524017:0.text: I will assist Satrana and try to find the rightful owners of the recovered relics.
say:23:1111524017:0.source_cn: 我会帮助萨忒娜，试着为带回的遗物寻找失主。

say:24:1111524018:0.text: Upon seeing the relics, the families should know we speak the truth.
say:24:1111524018:0.source_cn: 看到那些遗物，家属应该会知道我们所言非虚。

say:26:1111524019:0.text: I'm going to help too! It can't just be Satrana and Antandra doing all the work!
say:26:1111524019:0.source_cn: 我也要帮忙。不能只让萨忒娜姐姐和安丹姐姐出力！

say:31:1111524021:0.text: Thank you for the kind gesture, but you'd better return to your clan.
say:31:1111524021:0.source_cn: 谢谢你的好意，但你还是赶紧回到族人身边吧。

say:32:1111524022:0.text: Soren, look at the worried faces of those around you.
say:32:1111524022:0.source_cn: 索恩，你看周围这些人脸上担忧的面容。

say:33:1111524023:0.text: At this moment, your loved ones probably look the exact same way. Go home and put their worries to rest.
say:33:1111524023:0.source_cn: 此时此刻，你的亲人们可能也是同样的表情。快回去吧，别让...

say:35:1111524024:0.text: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a pleasure to have you with us. Without you, I might never have found Antandra.
say:35:1111524024:0.male: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a pleasure to have you with us. Without you, I might never have found Antandra.
say:35:1111524024:0.female: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's been a pleasure to have you with us. Without you, I might never have found Antandra.

say:36:1111524025:0.source_cn: 请让我郑重地说一声谢谢。

say:38:1111524026:0.text: It's time to say goodbye again...

say:39:1111524027:0.text: Do not be sad about our parting.

say:40:1111524028:0.text: Your destinies, though ripe with challenges, shine brighter than the stars.
say:40:1111524028:0.source_cn: 诸位的命运虽然注定坎坷，但一定闪耀着比星辰更璀璨的光芒。

say:41:1111524029:0.text: Someday, somewhere, we will meet again!
say:41:1111524029:0.source_cn: 有朝一日，我们一定会在世界的某处再次重逢！

say:44:1111524013:0.text: If you're telling the truth... why do you look so sad, like you're lying? *Sob*
say:44:1111524013:0.source_cn: 如果是真的……你的眼神……为什么像是在撒谎？呜呜呜——
say:44:1111524013:0.male: If you're telling the truth... why do you look so sad, like you're lying? *Sob*
say:44:1111524013:0.female: If you're telling the truth... why do you look so sad, like you're lying? *Sob*

say:0:1111525001:0.text: Let's go bring our people back to the Uru Clan.
say:0:1111525001:0.source_cn: 走吧，带着族人回到乌尔氏族。

say:3:1111526002:0.text: Luckily no wounds seem severe... with a bit of rest, all will be bouncing around in no time.
say:3:1111526002:0.source_cn: 幸好伤得不重，回来疗养一阵，很快又能活蹦乱跳啦。

say:4:1111526003:0.text: Aren't you going to ask me about what we encountered?
say:4:1111526003:0.source_cn: 你不问问，我们遇见了什么？

say:5:1111526004:0.text: What's there to ask? When Soren's by your side, any dangerous quest seems like a breeze!
say:5:1111526004:0.source_cn: 哎呀，有什么好问的？无论遇到了什么危险，有你索恩在，都...

say:6:1111526005:0.text: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> accompanying you, I wasn't worried at all!
say:6:1111526005:0.male: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> accompanying you, I wasn't worried at all!
say:6:1111526005:0.female: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> accompanying you, I wasn't worried at all!

say:7:1111526006:0.text: *Cough*... actually, I shouldn't say I didn't worry at all. That might not be exactly true.
say:7:1111526006:0.source_cn: 咳咳……其实，也不能说一点都不担心，还是有那么一点的。

say:8:1111526007:0.text: But only a little bit! Because I believe in you!
say:8:1111526007:0.source_cn: 真的只有一点点哦！因为我相信你们嘛！

say:9:1111526008:0.text: Anyway, you're finally back! I'm so happy!
say:9:1111526008:0.source_cn: 总之！你终于回来啦，索恩。我很高兴！

say:14:1111526010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if you're not in a great hurry to leave, you must stay with us for a while!
say:14:1111526010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if you're not in a great hurry to leave, you must stay with us for a while!
say:14:1111526010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if you're not in a great hurry to leave, you must stay with us for a while!

say:15:1111526011:0.text: Of course, Chippy and Hammie are also welcome!
say:15:1111526011:0.source_cn: 我会好好招待你的！当然啦，还有满满和漫漫！
say:15:1111526011:0.male: Of course, Chippy and Hammie are also welcome!
say:15:1111526011:0.female: Of course, Chippy and Hammie are also welcome!

say:16:1111526012:0.text: I've prepared some of your favorite treats! Ready for a feast?
say:16:1111526012:0.source_cn: 我准备了不少你们喜欢吃的东西！期待吗？
say:16:1111526012:0.male: I've prepared some of your favorite treats! Ready for a feast?
say:16:1111526012:0.female: I've prepared some of your favorite treats! Ready for a feast?

say:17:1111526013:0.text: Always ready! Chippy will help you vanquish those treats!

say:18:1111526014:0.text: Chippy... say thank you to Alsa.
say:18:1111526014:0.source_cn: 唉……满满，要记得谢谢阿尔萨哦。

say:19:1111526015:0.text: Thank you, Alsa, and also, everyone in the Uru Clan for hosting us!
say:19:1111526015:0.source_cn: 谢谢阿尔萨！谢谢乌尔氏族的招待！

say:20:1111526016:0.text: You're welcome! In my eyes, you are all family.
say:20:1111526016:0.source_cn: 客气什么！在我眼里，你们也是我的家人！

subtitle:1:1111521701:.text: Go back to where you belong, Hypogean!

subtitle:1:1111521703:.text: You mortals have no idea who you're messing with.
subtitle:1:1111521703:.source_cn: 凡人，你们还不知道自己在做什么

subtitle:1:1111521704:.text: The so-called gods you worship are not what—

subtitle:2:1111401001:.text: Thy name is Soren... Thou are my chosen.
subtitle:2:1111401001:.source_cn: 汝名……索恩，汝乃吾选定之人

cinematic_dialogue:2:1111518002:.text: You monster! Don't you dare hurt my people!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1111518002:.source_cn: 你这怪物！休想伤害我的族人！

subtitle:2:1111401002:.text: I bequeath unto thee great power.
subtitle:2:1111401002:.source_cn: 吾已将至高力量赐予你

subtitle:2:1111401003:.text: Go forth... And repel that which disturbs my slumber.
subtitle:2:1111401003:.source_cn: 去吧，将打搅吾长眠之物……驱逐

say:4:1111517001:0.text: How long have I waited? Memory is a precarious thing... even I am not immune to its loss.
say:4:1111517001:0.source_cn: 我已经等了多久？记忆可真脆弱，即便是我也不例外。

say:5:1111517002:0.text: My name is Phraesto. I have been alone here for ages, much akin to a prisoner.
say:5:1111517002:0.source_cn: 我名为普鲁斯托。长久以来，我孤独地待在这里，像个被囚禁...

say:6:1111517003:0.text: But what was my offense, and where was my trial? Who is qualified to condemn one such as me?
say:6:1111517003:0.source_cn: 可我的罪名是什么？谁能将我审判？谁有资格来定我的罪？

say:7:1111517004:0.text: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...
say:7:1111517004:0.source_cn: 你有资格吗？\n——继承了梅林之名的大魔法师。
say:7:1111517004:0.male: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...
say:7:1111517004:0.female: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...

choice_prompt:8:1111517004.text: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...
choice_prompt:8:1111517004.source_cn: 你有资格吗？\n——继承了梅林之名的大魔法师。
choice_prompt:8:1111517004.male: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...
choice_prompt:8:1111517004.female: Do you make such a claim? You, the great mage known as Merlin...

say:9:1111517005:0.text: Oh? Then tell me, what am I guilty of? What warrants being locked away by that detestable goddess?
say:9:1111517005:0.source_cn: 哦？那你便说说，我究竟曾犯过什么罪？至于被那可憎的女神...
say:9:1111517005:0.male: Oh? Then tell me, what am I guilty of? What warrants being locked away by that detestable goddess?
say:9:1111517005:0.female: Oh? Then tell me, what am I guilty of? What warrants being locked away by that detestable goddess?

say:10:1111517007:0.text: You cannot name a single transgression, and from this standpoint, I do not see myself guilty of any offense.
say:10:1111517007:0.source_cn: 你们甚至说不出我犯下的过错，站在我的角度，我不认为自己...

say:11:1111517008:0.text: Does a sinless Hypogean deserve to suffer confinement just for their very nature?
say:11:1111517008:0.source_cn: 一位无罪的恶魔，难道只因他是恶魔，就该遭受这被囚禁的苦难吗？

say:13:1111517009:0.text: Filthy Hypogean, your twisted tongue has no effect! Your crimes have been well documented!
say:13:1111517009:0.source_cn: 恶魔，你这是狡辩！你们当年的罪行都有记录！

say:14:1111517010:0.text: Do you refer to the type of historical gossip that anyone might fashion as they please?
say:14:1111517010:0.source_cn: 你是指那种谁都可以写上两笔的历史杂谈吗？不管是达官贵族...

say:15:1111517011:0.text: You say I am guilty, then of what charge? Did anyone witness my crimes with their own eyes?
say:15:1111517011:0.source_cn: 你说我有罪，我的罪名是什么？证据在何处？有人亲眼见证了...

say:16:1111517012:0.text: Impish little familiar, the world always views powerful forces beyond its control as evil... yet you know nothing of true power.
say:16:1111517012:0.source_cn: 小小使魔，世人总是把他们无法掌控的强大力量视为罪恶，而...

say:19:1111517013:0.text: I wish the goddess hadn't forgotten to seal your mouth as well.
say:19:1111517013:0.source_cn: 那位女神封印你的时候，怎么偏偏忘了堵住你的嘴？

say:20:1111517014:0.text: You're the one who knows nothing.
say:20:1111517014:0.source_cn: 我看一无所知的那个，是你吧？

say:21:1111517015:0.text: Oh, but courageous child... I know you.
say:21:1111517015:0.source_cn: 哦……有勇气的孩子。我知道你。

say:22:1111517016:0.text: Ironically, when Dura sealed me away, she borrowed the remaining power of the Dusk Lord.
say:22:1111517016:0.source_cn: 说来可笑，艾雅将我封印时，借用了残阳神余留的力量。

say:23:1111517017:0.text: Therefore, like you, I sometimes hear the whispers of his voice...
say:23:1111517017:0.source_cn: 因此，我也和你一样，偶尔能听见残阳神那烦扰的声音。

say:24:1111517018:0.text: The Dusk Lord has always believed that you would find and defeat me...
say:24:1111517018:0.source_cn: 残阳神一直相信你会来，相信你们能够将我打败。呵呵呵……

say:25:1111517019:0.text: Unfortunately for you, this is a fallacy.
say:25:1111517019:0.source_cn: 很遗憾，很快你们便会得知，这只是无稽之谈。

subtitle:28:1111401001:.text: Thy name is Soren... Thou are my chosen.
subtitle:28:1111401001:.source_cn: 汝名……索恩，汝乃吾选定之人

cinematic_dialogue:28:1111518002:.text: You monster! Don't you dare hurt my people!
cinematic_dialogue:28:1111518002:.source_cn: 你这怪物！休想伤害我的族人！

subtitle:28:1111401002:.text: I bequeath unto thee great power.
subtitle:28:1111401002:.source_cn: 吾已将至高力量赐予你

subtitle:28:1111401003:.text: Go forth... And repel that which disturbs my slumber.
subtitle:28:1111401003:.source_cn: 去吧，将打搅吾长眠之物……驱逐

say:30:1111519001:0.text: Soren is unaffected! Chippy, have everyone move next to Soren!
say:30:1111519001:0.source_cn: 索恩没有受到影响……满满！快把大家拉到索恩跟前！

say:31:1111519002:0.text: Soren has the Mark of the Setting Sun... If we stay close, we can resist Phraesto's magic!
say:31:1111519002:0.source_cn: 索恩身体内有残阳神的力量，待在他周围，可以抵御普鲁斯托...

say:36:1111519004:0.text: Planning on hiding behind that child for the rest of your short lives?
say:36:1111519004:0.source_cn: 所以，你们最终决定在那个孩子边上躲一辈子？

say:37:1111519005:0.text: Of course not! We'll defeat you!
say:37:1111519005:0.source_cn: 才不会呢！我们要打败你！

say:39:1111519006:0.text: Why such hostility? I, Phraesto, am the Hypogean that can remedy this world's sadness.
say:39:1111519006:0.source_cn: 为何要对我充满敌意呢？我，普鲁斯托，是可以让世人获得幸...

say:40:1111519007:0.text: In my illusions, departed loved ones return home to their kin with open arms.
say:40:1111519007:0.source_cn: 在我的幻术中，逝去的至亲会再次展开双臂，给予拥抱。

say:41:1111519008:0.text: Scorned lovers reunite and never betray one another again.
say:41:1111519008:0.source_cn: 分别的恋人也会重归于好，永不背叛。

say:42:1111519009:0.text: No one needs endure the travesties of illness, poverty, or war. All may live in peace and prosperity while flourishing in everlasting youth.
say:42:1111519009:0.source_cn: 人们不必再忍受病痛、穷苦、战争，所有人都会长久地生活在...

say:43:1111519010:0.text: If you would like to assign a duration to the length of these generous illusions, I offer my lifespan as the criterion.
say:43:1111519010:0.source_cn: 如果要为我的幻术附上期限，那么，我愿以自己的寿命作为标准。

say:44:1111519011:0.text: And as a Hypogean, I am immortal!
say:44:1111519011:0.source_cn: 身为恶魔，我的寿命是永远！

say:45:1111519012:0.text: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?
say:45:1111519012:0.source_cn: 继承了梅林之名的魔法师！你不想拥有永恒的幸福吗？
say:45:1111519012:0.male: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?
say:45:1111519012:0.female: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?

choice_prompt:46:1111519012.text: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?
choice_prompt:46:1111519012.source_cn: 继承了梅林之名的魔法师！你不想拥有永恒的幸福吗？
choice_prompt:46:1111519012.male: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?
choice_prompt:46:1111519012.female: The one known as Merlin—do you not wish for eternal bliss?

say:47:1111519013:0.text: Are illusions that last all eternity not just another form of reality?
say:47:1111519013:0.source_cn: 永恒的虚假，不正是另一种真实吗？
say:47:1111519013:0.male: Are illusions that last all eternity not just another form of reality?
say:47:1111519013:0.female: Are illusions that last all eternity not just another form of reality?

say:50:1111519015:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've heard enough of this nonsense.
say:50:1111519015:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've heard enough of this nonsense.
say:50:1111519015:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've heard enough of this nonsense.

say:55:1111519014:0.text: Foolish enough to believe my time will come to an end?
say:55:1111519014:0.source_cn: 难道你认为，死亡终有一日也会降临在我的身上？可笑。
say:55:1111519014:0.male: Foolish enough to believe my time will come to an end?
say:55:1111519014:0.female: Foolish enough to believe my time will come to an end?

narration:56:11010115:0.text: Phraesto's whispers echo inside the tomb, causing everyone but Soren to hallucinate.
narration:56:11010115:0.source_cn: 普鲁斯托的低语回荡在墓穴之中，让你们眼前不断出现幻觉，...

say:57:1111517006:0.text: Clever boy, for indeed you shouldn't.
say:57:1111517006:0.source_cn: 聪明的孩子，你的确没有。
say:57:1111517006:0.male: Clever boy, for indeed you shouldn't.
say:57:1111517006:0.female: Clever girl, for indeed you shouldn't.

narration:58:11010115:0.text: Phraesto's whispers echo inside the tomb, causing everyone but Soren to hallucinate.
narration:58:11010115:0.source_cn: 普鲁斯托的低语回荡在墓穴之中，让你们眼前不断出现幻觉，...

say:4:1111522101:1.text: Oh, dearest Phraesto, you shaped up to be quite a disappointment, didn't you?
say:4:1111522101:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀……普鲁斯托，你这家伙太令我失望了。

say:5:1111522102:1.text: With all that power of yours, failure did not seem an option.
say:5:1111522102:1.source_cn: 我还以为凭你的力量，这次一定不会失手。

say:6:1111522103:1.text: Having said that, what sort of power must they have been granted by the gods?
say:6:1111522103:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来，他们从神明那里得到的力量是什么呢？

say:7:1111522104:1.text: To be able to deliver a fatal blow to a Hypogean is... concerning.
say:7:1111522104:1.source_cn: 那个能够给予恶魔最后一击的力量……究竟是什么。

say:9:1111522106:1.text: I hate it... Scheming is not my forte. And <style="highlight">Their Excellency</style> is always giving me the most difficult tasks.
say:9:1111522106:1.source_cn: 唉，真讨厌，我最不擅长动脑子了。<style=high...

say:10:1111522107:1.text: Oh, never mind... I'll simply have to try harder so as not to anger them.
say:10:1111522107:1.source_cn: 算了算了……为了不惹祂老人家生气，我就再努力一点吧。

narration:12:11010116:0.text: In the tranquil depths of the Dusk Lord's tomb, Berial silently appears.
narration:12:11010116:0.source_cn: 恢复平静的残阳神墓穴中，贝利尔悄无声息地出现了。
